name: Exam Prep Dev Container
initializeCommand: bash -lc 'if [ ! -f "$HOME/.gitconfig-shared" ]; then if [ -f "$HOME/.gitconfig" ]; then cp "$HOME/.gitconfig" "$HOME/.gitconfig-shared"; else touch "$HOME/.gitconfig-shared"; fi; fi'
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; fi'
